mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to monetary tightening, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which is typically associated with a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and negative returns is not significant (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, which is likely to reduce corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS drops > 5% MoM do not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases > 2% MoM do not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rising > 200k does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline by more than 2% month-over-month, it signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which is likely to reduce corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 10% YoY and RSAFS drops > 2% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS declines does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-side constraint that can lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).
